Definition: from G1223 and a derivative of G3571; to sit up the whole night:--continue all night.
BiblicalUsage: To spend the whole night is what Jesus does once, and Luke records it simply: He went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God. The next morning He chooses the twelve.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the night of prayer before the choosing of the twelve is the pattern for every great decision; Jesus did not rush the choosing; He spent the night with His Father first, and so should I.
